description: Internal utilities and class definitions for implementing death tests in Google Test framework, including DeathTest class, factory interfaces, and related macros.

classes.name: DeathTest
classes.description: Abstract class encapsulating death test execution logic, including creation, role assumption, waiting, and result reporting.

classes.name: DeathTestFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating DeathTest instances, allowing for mocking in tests.

classes.name: DefaultDeathTestFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of DeathTestFactory for standard death test creation.

classes.name: InternalRunDeathTestFlag
classes.description: Represents parsed data from the --gtest_internal_run_death_test flag, including file, line, index, and write file descriptor.

methods.name: DeathTest::Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a DeathTest object based on current test parameters.

methods.name: DeathTest::LastMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable message about the last death test outcome.

methods.name: DeathTest::set_last_death_test_message
methods.description: Sets the message describing the last death test outcome.

methods.name: DefaultDeathTestFactory::Create
methods.description: Creates a DeathTest object for normal use.

methods.name: ExitedUnsuccessfully
methods.description: Checks if an exit status indicates a process that was terminated by a signal or exited with a nonzero code.

methods.name: ParseInternalRunDeathTestFlag
methods.description: Parses the internal_run_death_test flag and returns an InternalRunDeathTestFlag object if present.
